name: Jaded London
notes: jadedldn.com returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch on / and /collections/all (2026-10-28). No workaround tried. A human must open the site to confirm the store, known_for, sizes, shipping, returns and USD prices.

founded_year 2013 and founders Jade and Grant Goulden (siblings) come from Wikipedia, which cites The Times, Vogue Business and Dazed. Wikipedia calls it a UK 'streetwear brand' but gives no HQ city; hq_country GB is from 'based in the United Kingdom'.

The Urban Outfitters UK stockist page (fetched) describes it as a UK-based streetwear label founded in East London around 2013, 'Y2K realness with a rebellious edge'. Its 72 listed products were mostly tops (~20) and joggers/trousers/cargos (~18), plus jeans (~8) and dresses (~8). This is stockist copy, not the brand's own words.

Search-index titles of the brand's own pages (WebSearch only, not fetched) include 'Women's Streetwear & Clothing' (/collections/womens-all), 'Curated Premium Streetwear for Women' (/collections/womens) and 'Women's Baggy Jeans'. A search summary quoted US Colossus jeans at $165-$195. That figure is unverified and not stored.
Gate impact: the anchor is not verified and has no streetwear price, so the page fails missingAnchorFacts until a human verifies it.
